problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify the real CRTOS CircularAreaRelease using the unified circular_area_state/store_circular_area resource. Preserve executable C tokens. Release must consume the unique descriptor and backing buffer ownership.
problem_context.expected_behavior: A valid live circular area is reset in-place only as an implementation step, then its backing allocation and descriptor allocation are freed. The function returns no circular-area resource; unrelated GlobalStrings are preserved.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Public With uses abstract state and LitMap only. Require GlobalStrings(LitMap) * store_circular_area(state,circular_area). Ensure GlobalStrings(LitMap), with no store_circular_area remaining. Internal x_free contracts may use existential implementation witnesses needed to consume the two allocations.
spec_hint: Open store_circular_area only in an internal Assert, perform field updates, then call data-buffer free and descriptor free specs. Do not use obsolete CircularAreaBackingResource in the public Release contract. Do not claim the pointer remains usable after release.
preferred_hidden_properties: Keep buffer/index/status/operations/physical existential inside store_circular_area at the public boundary; consume them internally during deallocation.
forbidden_patterns: Do not modify executable C tokens.

known_risks: The unified-resource unfolding remains one expected downstream manual entailment; it must be proved rather than bypassed.
annotation_design_summary.mathematical_spec: Consume store_circular_area(state,circular_area), deallocate both owned allocations, preserve GlobalStrings, and return no usable circular-area resource.
preferred_hidden_properties_used: The unified resource hides buffer/index/status/operations/physical witnesses at the public boundary and opens them only for deallocation.
